method: BF16 SiLU-round/Mul-round/per128 FP8 quantization fusion, 16 launch geometries
scope: component only; synthetic hidden; real checkpoint layer38, TP8 rank0 expert tiles/router; no entire target model
baseline: Reused successful r9270b component complete Torch activation+quant chain; this is not the deployed Native activation baseline
per_card: independent 4 CPU rank, one local device bound by SLURM_LOCALID; same-card 4 ABBA pairs, fullwall/event samples retained
promotion: At least 3/4 positive fullwall pairs and median >=5% at each fullchain T for component retention; no model or service qualification
GPU_GATE: Root must ordinary-push exact source+claim; controller requires published commit then fresh sacct/KFD/node-free dedup of both parents before one bounded batch. No resubmission on unknown state.
cleanup: No TP collectives, each rank normal gc/emptycache; root/owner post-step KFD check required. Component output is not a model quality result.
